message: The SPARQL constraint only reports a violation when a case displacement is greater than DUI. It therefore permits DUI values greater than the greatest waterline-case displacement, even though the source requires DUI to be the displacement corresponding to the greatest displacement. The query does not establish equality with the maximum case value.
excerpt:
$this nltl:hasUpperIceWaterlineCase ?case .
                    ?case nltl:waterlineCaseDisplacement ?caseQuantity .
                    ?caseQuantity qudt:numericValue ?caseValue ;
                                  qudt:unit unit:KiloTON_Metric .
                    FILTER (?caseValue > ?upperValue)
expected: For every admitted ship, DUI must equal the greatest valid displacement among all waterline cases used to determine the UIWL. Both DUI below the maximum and DUI above the maximum must be rejected.
